title: Engine crashes on animation name with a float
body:
### Tested versions

I am using version 4.5.1.


### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8750H CPU @ 2.20GHz (12 threads) - 15.24 GiB memory

### Issue description

I am manually creating an animation in the following form:

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var adjustment = randf_range(-0.3, 0.3)
	var animation = Animation.new()
	var track_index = animation.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
	animation.track_set_path(track_index, ":position:y")
	animation.track_insert_key(track_index, 0.0, -10)
	animation.track_insert_key(track_index, 1.0 + adjustment, 0)
	animation.length = 1.0 + adjustment
	var library = $AnimationPlayer.get_animation_library("global")
	var name = "rise_" + str(adjustment)
	print(name)
	library.add_animation(name, animation)
	$AnimationPlayer.play("global/" + name)
```
